item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00497","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C05","C20","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"C05 is the closest structural analogue: it transmits proposed legislation, explains simplification of an existing statutory funding structure, describes the bill’s operative effects, and urges enactment. C20 likewise presents a draft bill, explains its administrative machinery, and notes an attached analysis. C11 shares the child’s near-contemporaneous Kennedy-era legislative-transmittal form and closing language. But these similarities are conventional features of presidential bill-transmittal letters. None contains distinctive shared language, a matching sequence of substantive provisions, or the same legal machinery concerning the Small Business Administration revolving fund, removal of program-specific appropriation limits, congressional oversight, or Treasury interest calculations. The small-business references elsewhere among the candidates provide background policy overlap rather than evidence of a reusable drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am transmitting herewith for appropriate reference a bill to amend section 4(c) of the Small Business Act, as amended.","parent_excerpt":"Accordingly, I transmit herewith for consideration by the Congress a draft of a bill","explanation":"C05 shares the legislative-transmittal convention, but this is routine language and the proposed legislation concerns unrelated refugee and migration programs."},{"child_excerpt":"This bill would place the fund on a more permanent basis and eliminate unnecessary duplication","parent_excerpt":"the statutory structure for them can be simplified and consolidated into one law","explanation":"C05 shares an abstract simplification rationale, but the actual statutory structures and operative changes are materially different."},{"child_excerpt":"A detailed analysis of the bill is attached.","parent_excerpt":"Also enclosed is a section-by-section analysis of the bill.","explanation":"C20 has the same supporting-document convention, but that is standard administrative boilerplate and does not establish substantive templating."},{"child_excerpt":"The proposed legislation would also simplify the method of computing the interest payable from the revolving fund to the Treasury, and would effect a number of clarifications","parent_excerpt":"This legislation will also effect a small number of other changes designed to make it more effective.","explanation":"C11 has a modest verbal and functional resemblance, but the phrasing is generic and supplies no matching legal or administrative machinery."}]}
